author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices climbing patterns, a pattern moved lower, two-part song shape, walking and running notes, and two-hand teamwork, with an old barn-dance fiddle tune.

classes.title: Five fingers in the barn
classes.goal: Find the five-finger place on C and play one finger on each key up to G.

mathTarget.parentLine: Using the two black keys to find where the hand lives

classes.parentPrompt: Help the thumb find C, left of the two black keys; say the finger numbers aloud.
classes.childAction: Thumb on C, then one finger on each key up to G.
classes.bridge: Two black keys are the barn roof; C is the barn door just left of it.

intro.caption: Find the barn door, C
intro.parentCue: help the thumb land left of the two black keys

games.caption: One finger, one key
games.parentCue: Say the finger numbers, one to five

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding the hand's place by a landmark.

classes.title: Climb up, stomp, stomp
classes.goal: Play the line that climbs E, F, G and then stomps on G.

mathTarget.parentLine: A little climb, then the same note again and again

classes.parentPrompt: Stomp one foot gently on each repeated G while your child plays.
classes.childAction: Climb E, F, G, then stomp G, G, and climb again.
classes.bridge: Three quick stairs up to the hayloft, then stomp, stomp on the top step.

intro.caption: Climb up, then stomp
intro.parentCue: stomp a foot gently on each repeated G

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: a climbing pattern that repeats.

classes.title: Three Es, then three Ds
classes.goal: Play the line with three Es and then the same shape lower: three Ds.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same shape again, starting one key lower

classes.parentPrompt: Count 'one, two, three' on the Es, then slide your child's hand one key left for the Ds.
classes.childAction: Play three Es, then the same shape one key lower: three Ds.
classes.bridge: The second group is the same little dance, one step down the barn stairs.

intro.caption: Same dance, one step lower
intro.parentCue: count three on the Es, then three on the Ds

games.caption: Three Es, three Ds, slowly
games.parentCue: Count 'one, two, three' on each group

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing the same pattern one step lower.

classes.title: Part A, Part B
classes.goal: Play the whole tune slowly and notice it has two parts: A, then B.

mathTarget.parentLine: A tune can be built from two different parts

classes.parentPrompt: Stomp softly during Part A and clap during Part B; sing 'da da' if your child gets stuck.
classes.childAction: Play slowly and spot when Part B starts.
classes.bridge: Part A dances on the barn floor; Part B climbs up high to the hayloft.

intro.caption: Stomp for A, clap for B
intro.parentCue: stomp on Part A, clap when Part B starts

games.caption: Tap the beat: the first line
games.parentCue: Play the blue keys; your child taps the beat

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing the two parts of a tune.

classes.title: Run-ning, walk, walk
classes.goal: Play the Part B start slowly: two quick notes, then two walking ones.

mathTarget.parentLine: Quick notes come two for every one walking step

classes.parentPrompt: Say 'run-ning' for quick pairs and 'walk' for slow notes while your child plays.
classes.childAction: Play the quick pairs as run-ning, the slow Gs as walk.
classes.bridge: A walking note is one big boot step; run-ning is two quick dancing feet.

intro.caption: Run-ning, walk, walk
intro.parentCue: say the words slowly as your child plays

games.caption: Part B start, slowly
games.parentCue: Help the pinky stretch up to A

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: fitting two quick notes into one beat.

classes.title: Stomp on one
classes.goal: Play one low left-hand note at the start of each bar, like a dancer's stomp.

mathTarget.parentLine: Each bar has four beats; the low note lands on one

classes.parentPrompt: Play the tune while your child plays the low notes. Count one-two-three-four, loud on one.
classes.childAction: Play one low note on every big one, then wait three beats.
classes.bridge: The low note is the dancer's big stomp on the barn floor, far to the left.

intro.caption: Low note on one
intro.parentCue: count to four, loud on one

games.caption: Same name, lower house
games.parentCue: Point left on each low C

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: landing on the first beat of each bar.

classes.title: One stomp, eight quick
classes.goal: Play the quick tune with one low left-hand note per bar, very slowly.

mathTarget.parentLine: One low note while the right hand plays eight quick ones

classes.parentPrompt: Rest a hand on your child's left shoulder and say 'stomp' on each bar. Go very slowly.
classes.childAction: Left hand stomps one low note; right hand runs eight quick notes.
classes.bridge: The left hand is the big boot stomp; the right hand is the fiddle running.

intro.caption: One stomp, eight quick
intro.parentCue: say 'stomp' on each bar, very slowly

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a slow part and a quick part together.

classes.title: Dance with the fiddle
classes.goal: Play the whole tune along with the music at full speed.

mathTarget.parentLine: Keeping up with a beat that does not wait

classes.parentPrompt: Sit beside your child and tap your foot on every one; cheer for keeping going, not notes.
classes.childAction: Play along with the music and keep going, even after a slip.
classes.bridge: The fiddle keeps the barn dance going; dance along, even past a stumble.

intro.caption: Hop on and keep dancing
intro.parentCue: tap your foot on one and smile at slips

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping up with the music together.

classes.title: Barn-dance concert for teddy
classes.goal: Play the whole tune for teddy with a lively, stomping sound, then bow.

mathTarget.parentLine: Playing the same notes with a lively dancing feel

classes.parentPrompt: Seat teddy as the audience; stomp and clap along while your child plays, then bow.
classes.childAction: Play lively for teddy, like a barn dance, then take a bow.
classes.bridge: Play like a barn full of dancers: bright, bouncy, then one big final stomp.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole tune with a lively feel.
